sections.shortTitle: Prohibition of Division of Residential Plots Ordinance 1997
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ORDINANCE XXII OF 1997
ORDINANCE XXII OF 1997
PROHIBITION OF DIVISION OF
RESIDENTIAL PLOTS ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to prohibit division or
sub‑division of residential plots in Islamabad
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 4th February, 1997]
No.F.2(1)/97‑Pub., dated 4‑2‑1997,‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient to prohibit
division or sub‑division of residential plots in Islamabad Capital
Territory and to provide for matters connected therewith and incidental
thereto;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.‑‑‑(1)
This Ordinance may be called the Prohibition of Division of Residential Plots
Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It extends to the Islamabad
Capital Territory.
(3) It
shall come into force at once.

2. Definitions.‑‑In this Ordinance,
unless there. is anything repugnant in the subject or context,‑‑
(a) "Authority" means the
Capital Development Authority established under the Capital Development
Authority Ordinance, 1960 (XXIII of 1960); and
(b) "plot" means a
residential plot forming part of a scheme approved by the Authority.

An Ordinance to prohibit division or
sub‑division of residential plots in Islamabad
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 4th February, 1997]
No.F.2(1)/97‑Pub., dated 4‑2‑1997,‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient to prohibit
division or sub‑division of residential plots in Islamabad Capital
Territory and to provide for matters connected therewith and incidental
thereto;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
3. Prohibition of division of
residential plots, etc.‑‑(1) Notwithstanding anything contained in any law, rules,
regulations or bye‑laws for the time being in force, deed of conveyance,
lease or the terms and conditions of allotment of a plot, no residential plot
shall be divided or sub‑divided into two or more smaller plots.
(2) No suit, appeal or application
for division or sub‑division of a plot shall, on commencement of this
Ordinance, be entertained by any Court and all such suits, appeals or
applications pending in any Court immediately before the commencement of this
Ordinance shall stand abated.

4. Penalty for Contravention.‑‑Whoever contravenes
the provision of section 3 or enters into an agreement for sale or disposal of
a portion of his plot or does anything which has the effect of a dividing or
sub‑dividing a plot shall be guilty of an offence punishable with
imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year or with fine which may
extend to one hundred thousand rupees, or with both, and the allotment, sale or
lease of the plot in his favour shall be cancelled by the Authority.
